text: パソコンで　しごと　ちゅう…　と　おもったら　ゲーム　だった！

structure.jp: パソコンで　しごと　ちゅう…

patterns.name: 〜と思ったら
patterns.explanation: と思ったら comes after what you first believed and leads into the surprise that it was wrong. と　おもったら　ゲーム　だった = 'or so I thought, but it was a game'.

patterns.name: 〜中
patterns.explanation: ちゅう after an activity means 'in the middle of' it. しごと　ちゅう = 'in the middle of working'.
